translatorNotes: FLAG — ACCOUNTING TERMINOLOGY VARIES ES (Spain) vs LATAM: several core terms have regional variants that a native reviewer should standardize to the target market. Choices made here (neutral international Spanish): onboarding → incorporación; document collection → recopilación de documentos; ledger/chart of accounts → plan de cuentas (LATAM often 'catálogo de cuentas'); month-end close → cierre de mes; engagement letter → hoja de encargo (a Spain/ES term; LATAM may prefer 'carta compromiso' / 'carta de encargo'); bookkeeper/accountant → contable (Spain; LATAM commonly 'contador'); practice software / practice management → software de gestión (LATAM may say 'software de gestión de despachos' or use the English term); intake form → formulario de admisión; tax returns → declaraciones; payroll → nóminas (LATAM often 'nómina'/'planilla'); bank feed → fuente/conexión bancaria. Reviewer must confirm the regional register.
Register: informal tú throughout, consistent with the rest of the ES site. No em-dashes used anywhere.

Kept exact: numbers, read-time (10 min de lectura), date (4 de agosto de 2026), percentages (65 por ciento, 70 por ciento, 15 a 20 por ciento), hours (2 a 4 horas, 48 horas), brand/tool names (QuickBooks, Xero, Karbon), acronyms (API, CRM, IA), 'Innovaria Tech Limited', email info@innovariatech.space, phone +1 601 860 1258. Currency: 'between $3,000 and $8,000' → 'entre 3.000 y 8.000 dólares'.

Internal links repointed to /es: brand → /es; nav Servicios/Sectores/Casos de éxito/Nosotros/Blog/Contacto and all submenu items → /es/...; body links (services/generative-ai-development, services/workflow-automation, industries/finance, contact) and Related-reading blog slugs (how-much-does-ai-automation-cost, ai-client-intake-automation-law-firms, best-automation-tools-service-businesses, cost-of-automating-lead-follow-up) → /es/...
